research_question: Can task decompositions be checked for dependency completeness before execution?

research_question: Can agent evaluation combine task success, recoverability, and user-intervention cost into one score?

benchmark: τ-bench, SWE-bench, WebArena, custom human-intervention simulations.

research_question: Can agent prompts be decomposed into testable behavioral assumptions?
